Power was estimated by resampling the observed facility-level values with replacement (B = 4000 replicates per cell, seed 20261123, facility counts 10, 15, 21, 28, 40, 60, 80, 100, 150, 200). Paired contrasts used the two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test with its normal approximation, Holm-adjusted jointly over the four contrasts of a city on joint facility resamples. Effects were searched from 0 to 0.06 in steps of 0.0005 and mean coverage from 0.88 to 0.93 in steps of 0.0005. The Monte Carlo standard error of a power estimate near 0.80 is 0.0063.
